position: Authorization is a recorded decision, never an implication from completed prototypes
headline: The evaluator can authorize private implementation only after every named prerequisite passes.
copy: The default project packet stays pending because no provider, region, owner, budget, identity provider, durable store, or real review evidence has been supplied.

postures.title: Decision contract
postures.copy: The evaluator and required evidence are explicit and testable.

postures.title: Founder decision
postures.copy: No private infrastructure implementation has been authorized.

postures.title: Provider and region
postures.copy: No vendor account, region, or endpoint is attached.

postures.title: Activation
postures.copy: Authorization for implementation would still not issue invitations.

flow.title: Name
flow.copy: Record provider, region, owners, and a budget cap.

flow.title: Prove
flow.copy: Attach security, privacy, rights, identity, storage, and recovery evidence.

flow.title: Decide
flow.copy: Approve private implementation, reject, or remain pending.

flow.title: Hold
flow.copy: Keep deployment and invitations closed after the decision.

decisions.label: Evaluator
decisions.reason: Unsafe and incomplete inputs are rejected deterministically.

locks.title: Deployment lock
locks.copy: No provider endpoint, domain, runtime, or credential is active.

locks.title: Identity lock
locks.copy: The claim contract does not authenticate a real reviewer.

locks.title: Storage lock
locks.copy: Ledger semantics are verified without a connected durable provider.

locks.title: Invitation lock
locks.copy: No invitation token, participant, or external session exists.

locks.title: Public launch lock
locks.copy: Implementation readiness cannot activate a public service.
